subject: Re: Dataset custody, access SOPs, and usage covenants (MAP draft)
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.com>, acme-data-ops@acme.com
Date: 2025-05-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Dataset exchange & MAP — next steps

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team at Acme Retail is keen to run Redwood models over a representative sample of our customer-support transcripts to validate intent classification accuracy and latency in our production flows. We discussed a mutual action plan (MAP) to exchange a sanitized dataset + prompt pack and to agree on usage constraints.

Can you send a short MAP draft that lays out:
- dataset handoff schedule and custody (who hosts which copy when)
- permitted uses & retention window
- redaction/anonymization expectations and evidence we can inspect
- export, derivative work, and deletion obligations
- checkpoints & acceptance criteria (perf targets, sample eval queries)

We’d like to close this by mid-June if possible. Attaching our minimal manifest and an internal TODO list for context.

Jordan
Director, Data Platform
Acme Retail
[attachment: acme_manifest_minimal.csv (CSV, 86KB)]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dataset exchange & MAP — next steps

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the manifest. I’ve sketched a short MAP and attached a working spreadsheet (redwood_map_template_v1.xlsx). High-level proposal below — this is intentionally narrow so we can iterate quickly: 

1) Timeline / milestones (target close: 2025-06-18)
   - 2025-06-02: Acme provides sanitized sample bundle (<= 2k rows) + prompt pack + manifest
   - 2025-06-04: Redwood confirms ingestion & basic data quality checks; share initial eval harness
   - 2025-06-11: Redwood returns evaluation report (accuracy/latency) and recommended generation configs
   - 2025-06-16: Joint review, agree on follow-up dataset needs or scope for production pilot

2) Custody & hosting
   - Acme supplies sample via encrypted S3 link (pre-signed, 7-day expiry) to Redwood ingest bucket. Redwood will store a copy in a customer-specific encrypted bucket with KMS key per Acme.
   - Access logs and object-versioning enabled; Redwood will provide manifest-level MD5 checksums and an ingestion report.

3) Usage constraints (draft)
   - Permitted uses: model evaluation, prompt tuning on sample only, and regression testing. No commercial redistribution.
   - Retention: Redwood retains the sample only for 60 days post-ingestion unless Acme requests deletion.
   - Derivatives: model weights and prompt-tuned artifacts that contain verbatim dataset excerpts are prohibited; summaries/embeddings/aggregate metrics allowed.

4) Evidence & auditability
   - Redwood will provide an ingestion report, access log snippet, and a redaction-sanity checklist for Acme review.

5) Acceptance criteria
   - Target metrics: intent F1 >= 0.82 on guardrail testcases; median inference P95 latency <= 110ms on dedicated test harness (batch size 1).

Legal note: I’ve looped in Kimberly from Legal to confirm the wording for retention and derivative restrictions. Ben (CS) — can you confirm we can hit the ingestion timeline?

Attachments: redwood_map_template_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), usage_covenants_draft.pdf (language preview)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_map_template_v1.xlsx (Excel, 56KB)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-01T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dataset exchange & MAP — next steps

Vivek — we can do the ingest on 6/2 as long as Acme provides the pre-signed link by end of day 6/1. Two operational notes:

- Please confirm sample size limit (<=2k rows) and that PII fields are already redacted by Acme; if they’re not, we’ll need an additional redaction pass which could slip the timeline by 3 business days.
- I’ll stand up an evaluation harness (single-host test runner) and will run the acceptance evals you listed. I’ll attach the harness runbook to the MAP spreadsheet.

Kimberly — legal flags for retention/derivative language? Happy to adopt whatever is required to keep this moving.

Ben
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-02T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dataset custody — retention & derivative language (draft)

Vivek / Ben — reviewed the draft usage covenants. Suggested edits summarized: 

- Retention: change 60 days -> 45 days by default; extendable by written request.
- Derivatives: replace "prohibited" with "restricted" and add narrow carve-outs for embedded metadata used in evaluation (embeddings allowed if they cannot be reverse-engineered to reconstruct verbatim data).
- Auditability: we will provide a redaction provenance summary (hashes + redaction script version) but cannot provide raw pre-redaction files.

I attached a redline (usage_covenants_draft.pdf). Assuming Acme accepts the 45-day retention and the restricted-derivatives language, we can sign off quickly.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts | Redwood Inference
[attachment: usage_covenants_draft.pdf (PDF, 22KB)]

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.com>, acme-data-ops@acme.com

Subject: Re: Dataset custody, access SOPs, and usage covenants (MAP draft)

Vivek / Kimberly / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Acme accepts the revised MAP and the 45-day retention window; the restricted-derivatives carve-out makes sense. We uploaded the sanitized sample bundle here: s3://acme-samples/redwood-eval-2025/sample_bundle_v1.csv (pre-signed link emailed to redwood-ingest@redwood.ai).

Next steps we propose:
- 2025-06-04: Redwood ingests the sample (please confirm receipt)
- 2025-06-11: Redwood returns the evaluation report
- 2025-06-16: Joint sync to review results and discuss pilot scope

Also attaching a short prompt pack for the initial evaluation and a short set of guarded testcases.

Jordan
Director, Data Platform | Acme Retail
